verdict.rationale: Notte's docs describe an action-space model where act/click/type target elements identified via a live observe() call rather than brittle CSS selectors, and the marketing copy explicitly claims 'No selectors, no maintenance,' matching the story's premise. However, there is no first-party benchmark or independent verification specifically showing action primitives survive DOM/layout changes, and a community commenter explicitly questions why an action space would be more reliable than screenshots+HTML, plus a hands-on failure report on a live site (hyatt.com) raises doubt about real-world robustness. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on evidence confirming resilience across layout changes, and a rebuttal to the community skepticism about action-space reliability.
